inputs.text: Nigeria’s political parties are supposed to serve the nation, not become private clubs for the wealthy. The concerns around the APC ahead of the 2027 elections point to a serious danger: when money matters more than public service and responsibility, ordinary families are pushed aside and trust in democratic life erodes. A party that wants to lead must remember its duty to the whole country.
